summary: Backend-only verification of Phase 1 post-onboarding Tina LLM chat. Seeded a MongoDB user_profiles doc (archetype Cozy Companion, Quality Time, intent 70/30, top movies La La Land/Casablanca/Spirited Away, genres Drama+Romance, Mumbai) and a tina_sessions doc with personality_360.phase='complete' so the new free-form LLM path runs (otherwise the 360 quiz intercept on lines 920-955 would short-circuit). Validated /api/tina/chat returns conversational, profile-aware, ≤1-emoji, short replies with show_options=null, show_movie_picker=false, completion_percentage=100. Tested 3-turn continuity (replies were distinct and on-topic, the last turn referenced 'film lover like you'). Negative test confirmed brand-new users with is_onboarding_complete=false still get scripted onboarding with show_options.field=='relationshipIntent'. Backend logs clean — no errors from _load_full_user_profile or the new LLM block. Voice transcribe smoke (POST /api/tina/voice/transcribe) accepted a WAV blob and returned a 'text' field. All 6 tests passed.
action_items: FLOW CAVEAT — please confirm: in tina_service.process_tina_message (lines 920-955), when is_onboarding_complete=True AND session.personality_360.phase=='inactive', the code unconditionally triggers the 360° persona quiz first (sends intro + first quiz question with chip options), NOT the new free-form LLM chat. So 'post-signup Tina' only enters the LLM free-form path AFTER the 8-question 360 quiz finishes (phase becomes 'complete'). If the original bug ('post-signup Tina out of sync') was reported on the very next message after signup completion, the user is actually hitting the 360 quiz (which is by design). The new LLM path is verified working for the post-360 stage. If main agent intends the new LLM path to run BEFORE 360 too, additional logic is needed.

Sample LLM replies captured during test (for sanity): T1='Hey Test User! 🌟 Since you're into drama and romance, how about Pride and Prejudice? It's got that classic charm and a cozy vibe perfect for a night in...'. T2='Gotcha, Test User! How about The Grand Budapest Hotel? It's quirky, full of laughs, and has that Wes Anderson charm... 🎥'. T3='How about a cozy movie night under the stars? Grab a projector, some comfy blankets... 💫'. Replies are conversational, reference Drama/Romance/cozy archetype, short, 1 emoji each, and distinct per turn. No scripted leakage. ✓

Optional polish: the rich profile prompt does not always cite the user's top movies by name (Pride and Prejudice was suggested instead of La La Land). Consider strengthening the system prompt with an explicit nudge like 'When suggesting a movie, prefer to either build on their Top 5 favorites or compare to them by name.'
critical_code_review_comments: tina_service.py is 1426 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into tina_orchestrator.py (process_tina_message + state) / tina_prompts.py (constants & system prompts) / tina_post_onboarding.py (the new LLM chat block) for maintainability.

tina_service.get_llm_response builds a single mega-prompt by concatenating system + history strings instead of using LlmChat's native multi-turn message list. Works, but loses any model-side context handling and bloats tokens; consider passing history as proper user/assistant message turns to LlmChat.
seed_data_creation: Inserted test docs into MongoDB user_profiles and tina_sessions for user_id 'TEST_tina_complete_user_001' and 'TEST_tina_incomplete_user_001'. Both are cleaned up in the module teardown fixture so no pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 backend LLM chat path verified. The natural flow on the frontend goes signup → onboarding wizard → 360 quiz (auto-triggered by is_onboarding_complete=true and personality_360.phase=='inactive') → only THEN enters the new free-form LLM chat. To exercise the LLM path directly in tests, pre-seed tina_sessions with personality_360.phase='complete' as shown in the test file. The new _load_full_user_profile correctly reads archetype/love_language/intent/topMovies/genres/filmLanguages/movieFrequency/ottTheatre/location.city from user_profiles and feeds them into a rich system prompt. EXPO_BACKEND_URL is exposed via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — Phase 1 was a feature addition. The previously scripted 'Wow, we covered a lot! Your profile is looking great...' line is no longer hit when is_onboarding_complete=true (it lived in the legacy onboarding path). Now the code first runs the 360 persona quiz (existing) and then, once complete, delegates to a rich LLM prompt that includes the user's archetype, love language, intent split, top movies, genres, languages, watch frequency, OTT/theatre pref, and city. Verified LLM replies are conversational, short, profile-aware, and emoji-limited.
